Tarot.Name: The Empress
Tarot.Desc: The Empress is about nature, fertility and prosperity. It’s about living a beautiful life and enjoying it to the fullest. Don’t save your best outfits for special occasions, wear them and make every day special. Burn the candles and stick the stickers you haven’t used. Eat foods that make you happy and fulfilled and sprinkle everything in your life with things you enjoy and makes life prettier for your eye. The Empress is filled with creative energy, so it is a great time to start something new, where you can be as creative as you can. Create with the joy of doing it and don’t worry about little details yet. The process of creating is as important as the creation. Nature is a great place to go to and get inspired. Enjoy the circle of everything, the rebirth and the dying. Find the beauty in every aspect of living.
Tarot.Money: As fertile this card is, it also is very fruitful when it comes to money. It’s giving you peace of mind through the promise of economic balance. But most importantly, you have to be thankful and learn to feel rich no matter of your situation, so you may manifest yourself a fuller wallet.
Tarot.Love: The Empress is always a positive sign when it comes to relationships. She is loving and loves everyone around her. Even herself. She reminds you that loving someone requires that you love yourself first. You are enough. Start from that, and then you’ll see that love and romantics are on your way. For the ones in a relationship, your love will be deepening. If you are dreaming of starting a family, this is the time to begin! If not, take care of prevention… this cards feminine and fertile energy might otherwise take you and your partner to a tricky situation.

Tarot.Name: The Sun
Tarot.Desc: Things are starting to fall on place and your future seems bright. It’s time to have fun and enjoy life. Things don’t need to be so complicated. Treat yourself and try to see the world as a place you are now seeing for the first time. In astrology your sun sign describes your personality, so this card is also suggesting you to find yourself. Leave self-hatred and doubts behind, since you are one of a kind and have nothing to be afraid of.
Tarot.Money: Be brave enough to ask for what you want, a pay rise or promotion. The Suns energy is allowing you to hope and promises good in financial matters too.
Tarot.Love: If you are in a relationship, this card means happiness and joy. Something to be celebrated might also occur, maybe engagement party or even a child if that’s what you are hoping for. As what comes to single ones, you are now the happiest you’ve been alone. You truly feel like you don’t need anyone by your side. Your happiness might lure someone in your life thought, and if the time feels right, you should let them in.

Tarot.Name: Death
Tarot.Desc: You are probably dealing with some kind of loss or change right now. Or is there something in your life that should not be there anymore? You cannot outrun Death, you’ll just have to decide how you greet them. Death helps you grow as a person - it removes from your life things that no longer serve you. When you are willing to truly let it go, you’ll get something so much better in change. This card might also quite literally mean actual death or illness, it’s truly not very common thought. Generally this card represents rebirth and life itself. Death helps you appreciate life in its complexness.
Tarot.Money: Death might suggest a situation where you suddenly loose a big amount of money, or your income changes drastically. You are supposed to take the situation as a needed lesson about your money habits or even life in general. Start spending less and avoid hoarding stuff. After all you cannot bring material goods to grave with you.
Tarot.Love: In the context of love, death usually means the end of a relationship or giving up old habits in it. Start thinking what is not working in your relationship and what you could do about it. If you don’t deal with difficult stuff, they will eventually build up and collapse onto itself. If you want the relationship to last, things must change. If that doesn’t help, perhaps it is time to finally let go. If you are single, you should change your own old habits to start building a strong relationship with someone.
Tarot.Keywords: Change, loss, endings, transition, letting go

Tarot.Name: The Tower
Tarot.Desc: You are facing a drastic change in your life. Something that has felt sure and safe isn’t on as solid of a ground you thought. This card doesn’t accept compromises or allow you to ignore what’s going to happen, and everything built to unstable structure will fall. The change is present in our physical world. It could mean losing your job or filing for bankruptcy, divorce, pandemia, earthquake, illness or even death of a close one. But sometimes we will have to face a total destruction to be able to start again and grow stronger. The healing process wont be easy, but its not meant to be. When it is all in the past, your life will be on the next level. Since you cant avoid the change, you might as well find that silver lining. You will find out what and who truly matters to you. Which people were with you through the hard times and what is truly important to you? You are about to find out.
Tarot.Money: Do you have any savings for a rainy day? It might be too late to create a savings account now, but if you can save up on expenses, do it now.
Tarot.Love: Storms eye is approaching. Your relationship will be tested but if you both know in your hearts it is worth fighting, it is. But if something is wrong, every bad omen you had about them in the beginning, will be shown true. Don’t feel bad about possible break up, its not your fault. After all, you’ve most likely learnt something. If you haven’t found a suitable partner, the reason according to this card is that you have propensity to develop drama and chaos around you.

Tarot.Name: Strength
Tarot.Desc: in a card of strength, you usually see a person with a lion. The person in the card looks calm and gentle and seems to be petting the lion. The calmness of the situation is telling of control. The person in this card know that it is the master of the situation and that treating the lion right, will lead it to be more cooperative. So you should start to treat the lion in you right. The better the terms you are in with your inner lion, the easier it is to use your inner strength and creativity. The lion is also mirroring the energy that lies within yourself. Imagine the power you’d have, if you did not put value into what others think or have to feel ashamed of yourself ever again. What was the last time you felt like yourself? What made you happy and excited as a child? You should really start dismantling the walls you’ve built and get back to your roots. The inner strength you have will help you to get over your fears, be yourself and live life to the fullest.
Tarot.Money: Drawing this card means that you probably have a stable situation with money, you just tend to spend it without a care. If you want the balance of your bank account to stay good, avoid impulse buys! With your confidence being on its peak, it is a good time to ask for a pay rise!
Tarot.Love: This card is about being brave and confident, so it is time to stop being afraid and start dating! No need to stress about finding a soulmate thought, you can always just enjoy fun dates and positive attention. You might end up getting serious with a bit wilder person, but remember, there might not be a way to tame them… If you are in a good relationship, this card marks strong love. If one of you tries to reflect their own self consciousnesses to your relationship, remember that you are stronger together, and will get over the issues.

Tarot.Name: The Star
Tarot.Desc: You should try to be grateful. Life has been very hard for you lately and you may have gone through a transformation. The star is now giving you a permit to relax and enjoy, since you are on the right path and one with the universe. Happiness and abundance are present, and you don’t have to try and grow, for you are good as you are. The Star is also heavily connected to creativity. You have likely found your thing and it makes creating easier for you. So making art is pretty easy for you now. Take advantage of it and write, paint, knit. cook… whatever your heart desires!
Tarot.Money: If money is thight, The Star is promising relief. If your job is offering you interesting possibilities, take them. Also, creative projects might give you a way to earn extra money. Perhaps try selling your art?
Tarot.Love: Have you finally let go of your ex? Since the shadows of the past are now behind and you have no trouble of being yourself, dating seems to be easy. Focus on having fun rather than obsessively looking for a partner, so they might come before you even notice.

Tarot.Name: Judgement
Tarot.Desc: Means a beginning of new era. It’s time to wake up from hibernation and look for signs the universe is giving to you and find your true calling. This card might also suggest that you should spread your wisdom so maybe your calling is in leadership. Judgement might also be telling you to bring back old hobbies. Have you forgotten something in the middle of busy everyday life? What are you missing in your life? Since you are moving to new era, bring only what matters with you.
Tarot.Money: If you are good at something, people are usually willing to pay for your services, so you might have found a new way of making money. On the other hand, this card might try to warn you about issues in your current financial balance. So be careful whatsoever.
Tarot.Love: This card is telling of judgmental behaviors considering love. If you are single, you might be too quick to judge someone even based on their looks. Perhaps you should get to know each other before you make any choices. If you are in a relationship, it might be shadowed by your past conflicts. Judgement is looking for conclusion, so either fix the problem and forgive or leave the whole relationship behind and move on.

Tarot.Name: The Hermit
Tarot.Desc: The hermit is an ascetic minimalist, who’s telling you to focus to conscious presence, instead of your smart devices. He doesn’t need a lot of unneeded things around him, so perhaps you should also start to think what is truly needed in your life. Take time to study yourself. You don’t have to withdraw completely but focus on the important relationships in your life. Also you do not need to focus on other people’s dramas. You could use a weekend at the cabin alone though, or just a short hike in the nature. Since the Hermit usually approaches you in a key stage of life where you are wondering who you are and what you want from life, he tells you that the truth lies within yourself. You just need to listen. As said beforehand, give less time to your phone and other devices, and calm down a bit to be able to focus.
Tarot.Money: Is your lifestyle focused on money and spending it on material goods? You should start thinking that what actually matters to you and learn the secrets of minimalism.
Tarot.Love: Unfortunately, single ones reading this should not be expecting much romance in their lives now. You should truly focus on yourself, before you can find a suitable partner. Think of what you really want in life, and what kind of person would fit in that scenery. In a relationship, this means you guys either spend too much time together or enjoy your alone time more than you should. It’s not good to be too dependent on your partner, but obviously you should not forget each other. Balance is key.

Tarot.Name: Justice
Tarot.Desc: When righteousness isn’t served, Justice arrives to settle accounts. Every decision you make will count from now on. Are you ready to take accountability of your actions? It’s time to define what you think is right or wrong. Are you making choices based on your own values, or do you allow others to influence your opinions? You should also wonder if you treat others right. When you have your truth figured out, Justice expects action rather than just big words. You may have to make hard choices since your surroundings might not match your values. Just keep in mind that these are not light choices, you’ll have to base them on real things.
Tarot.Money: It is time to estimate is your money going to right things. Justice is also telling you to concider if your job supports your values. If not, perhaps you should change things.
Tarot.Love: The people who aren’t good for you are about to be history. You will finally meet someone who treats you right, and the mistreating exes will get their karma. In a relationship your situation depends on the stage of your relationship. Since this card is about law, perhaps you shall get married soon. But if one of you is hiding something, the secrets will be revealed soon.

Tarot.Name: The Hierophant
Tarot.Desc: This card is probably one of the most multidimensional card of the deck. It’s about learning, knowledge and tradition. The hierophant is a teacher, who strives to be understood by most. So it makes sense you might be in a state of wanting to expand your awareness and learn new things. Might even be that you are going to meet a mentor, who will change your way of seeing things. Or you could just have a lesson to learn from life in general. Perhaps you should even start considering going back to studies. If you don’t agree, could it be ‘cause you have something you want to teach to others instead? But remember, you should stick to what you believe and stand behind it proudly.
Tarot.Money: Now it’s not the time to think big and bold. Lean to traditional ways of handling money, try not to spend too much and if you have issues, call to bank to ask for a professional.
Tarot.Love: This is the packs clearest sign of commitment and traditional marriage. Even if you don’t yet feel like going ring shopping, this is a sign that you have a deep connection. You share same values and plans for the future, and it creates a stable base for your relationship. Single ones might be having an inappropriate crush. But if you are wary and patient, a stable relationship might be on its way.

Tarot.Name: The Emperor
Tarot.Desc: The emperor is the embodiment of authority, confidence and leadership. He’s the king of the kings and a father figure. The card is commanding you to start doing and focusing on practical matter. And yes, it also means the boring stuff like budgeting. You need to face the challenges that slow you down and solve your problems. It’s no excuse if the situation feels chaotic. That’s exactly why you need to start getting your hands dirty. Set goals and if they seem hard cut chores to smaller areas. The important part is, just get it done and you’ll feel better. The emperor also encourages you to find the leader in yourself. If you don’t happen to hae a group to lead, take responsibility of your own life. Take inspiration of characters that have power, start dressing better, standing taller and looking confident. But remember, a great leader is not a dominant power hoarder. They respect and listen to others and cares for them
Tarot.Money: One of the “boring chores” you should start doing is observing your money habits. Start being conscious where you put your money towards to and start avoiding pointless spending. But do not start stressing though, it might ruin your manifestations and drive money away. In work life, your hard work will surely be noticed, so keep going!
Tarot.Love: If you are. single, you might be falling for someone older. Most likely, they are trustworthy and they make you feel safe, even though they are not very good with romantic chestures, let alone talking about their feelings. You should think if it is really the person you like, or just their authority. If you are in a relationship, this card is promising it will be long and stable. But if one of you seems to be more dominant in the relationship, it might be a good time to talk about it.

Tarot.Name: The Fool
Tarot.Desc: As the card number zero of the deck, it represents new beginnings. As you draw this card, new adventures open up in front of you. Even if you may be lost, you shall find your path soon. As this card advises, you should follow your heart and get on with it with the joy of a child and trust the universe. There’s no such thing as “you are not ready”, everyone has to start somewhere. If you can dream it, you can do it. And even though you failed, you will always survive. That’s the optimism of the Fool.
Tarot.Money: The Fool promises new possibilities. Perhaps now is the perfect time to switch workplace or start a business of your own. Even though your close people might not understand your dreams, don’t let it discourage you. If the work life of yours is fulfilling enough, look for opportunities outside that. Just don’t make a fool of yourself…
Tarot.Love: If you don’t already have a certain person in your mind, this is the time to search for one! Show the universe, that you are ready for love. Even if you don’t find someone truly potential, you could still meet someone fun and exciting. Spontaneity is one of the Fools features. For the ones that are already dating someone, the card might try to warn about a person who is not ready to commit. This person is purely for the joy of having someone for a while but remember not to fall too much in love. Enjoy while it lasts. If you are committed to someone, there might be first lovers’ kind of excitement in the air. But if something seems wrong you might have to think if one of you is not taking things seriously enough.
Tarot.Keywords: Adventure, inner child, new beginnings, innocence

Tarot.Name: The Lovers
Tarot.Desc: Today is about relationships and choises. Even if it may seem that this card has romantic load to it, it does also consider important platonic relationships and friendships in general. Has someone been on your mind lately? This cards important theme is dichotomy, so it seems you are undecicive what to do with a certain person. It’s time to make a decicion and not be scared of what comes next. What will happen, is meant to be. It could also mean, that the person is you, and you don’t yet know who you want to be. That is something, you should start thinking and make choices towards the person you dream to be.
Tarot.Money: The lovers are a sign of good fortune. Perhaps you shall meet a new business partner or a colleague, with whom your ideas bloom. Your skills and experience complement each other and you will make a lot of money together! This card might also have a work place romance on the horizon. Are you willing to mix work and free time?
Tarot.Love: If you are curious about your love life, this is a just as a good sign, as you thought it might be. A loved one is on its way, or if you have one already, this card is means sincere love that everyone around you seems to notice. They truly are your soulmate. If the person you are interested in seems cold and distant, they are not your soulmate. Make yourself a favor and move on. The most important thing is to love yourself first and build a good relationship with yourself.

Tarot.Name: The Magician
Tarot.Desc: The magician wants you to see every ability you have. The idea you have in your mind is now ready to be done. Usually in the card you can see every element of tarot represented. The cups, pentacles, swords and wands. Meaning you do not lack any resources, on the contrary, you have everything you need to start truly working towards your goal. But you should really consider the source of the motivation. Are you just in it for the money or status, or do you really want to do this thing? If so, forget what anyone has to say and believe in yourself. You have limitless potential and power within.
Tarot.Money: The magician is a positive sign in worklife and money. It’s a great moment for pay rise, promotion or perhaps new businesses. Just be wary of showing all your cards, magicians never reveal their secrets.
Tarot.Love: For the single folks this card might actually be a sign of a loved one to come to your life. If you already have this person in your life, it means that you guys truly are on the same level. They can also challenge you to be the best version of yourself. This kind of connection is rare, so make sure you don’t loose it. For the ones already committed, your relationship will be deepening. You will be committing in a deeper level. Maybe it is time to start talking about the next stage of your life together.

Tarot.Name: The High Priestess
Tarot.Desc: The High Priestess represents subconsciousness and intuition and works as a messenger between your conscious and subconscious mind. One key part of this card is to understand dichotomy of the things in life, and to find balance between things. As you got this card, it is the time to calm down and start looking for answers within yourself. Meditate, focus on the dreams you’ve had and search for signs that universe has sent you. Before all, trust your intuition. This card might also try to inform you that your calling might be helping others. Perhaps you should consider studies in health field? Or you might actually be a witch. If you haven’t been into witchy stuff early, now it might be the time to start learning about astrology, crystals and tarot.
Tarot.Money: This card doesn’t really have a connection to money. You might receive some key information that gets you upwards in corporate ladder, and for those in art field it promises inspiration and creativity.
Tarot.Love: Whatever your current status is, The High Priestess is about attraction. You might be in a situation that a lot of people have their eyes on you. Enjoy that, but be wary of the ones who might not have the best intentions. If you have a partner, this card is promising magic between the sheets, but not in the traditional procreational way.

Tarot.Name: The Chariot
Tarot.Desc: The chariot is a means of transport that is protecting you on your way to your destination. But the key to get there is found within yourself. Become a warrior and start challenging yourself and practice your self discipline. Figure out your weaknesses and start bettering them. You will not become a master in one night, but that’s just more of a reason to begin the journey today.
Tarot.Money: You are finally meeting your goals in work life! Perhaps your money issues will also be solved soon. This card also symbolizes traveling, so it might be the time to book the flight or buy the car. Hard work requires treating yourself too.
Tarot.Love: The chariot is not very romantic card. In this context, it most likely means that you will have to work for your relationship. Meaning, if you have issues with your significant other, it is time to search for solutions and fix the issue. Sometimes this card might also be a sign that you are proceeding too fast in your relationship. If they are the one for you, you shouldn’t have to hurry. For the single ones this might mean that you are still bothered about the issues in your past relationships. This is now your sign to let go of old grudges and move on.

Tarot.Name: The Devil
Tarot.Desc: Represents the darkness within each of us. It’s time to focus on your obsessions and dark side. What is standing between you and your dream life? Most likely the problem is found in yourself. For example, self-hatred and addictions can ruin your chances of being happy. Remind yourself that the you have the power to take control to get rid of things that aren’t good for you. Obviously, it is ok to randomly give in, drink too much and perhaps make some sin with someone unknown, that won’t be a problem. The Devil also reminds you to be able to laugh at yourself and have some fun.
Tarot.Money: You are probably too chill with your money. Try avoiding shopping and any kind of gambling. It is not wise to trust anyone else with your financial things right now, and if you end up investing money now, you might not get it back. Materialism is also a central theme of this card. Try to figure out are you just trying to buy happiness, or are the things you want truly necessary.
Tarot.Love: This is the most sexual card of the whole deck and has nothing to do with romance. You should let yourself enjoy the physical aspects of life and maybe try something new between the sheets. If you have casual fun with certain person, this is not the time to start planning a wedding. If you noticed that you have feelings for them, be careful, it might be one-sided. Are you too keen to your partner? If so, this card suggests you to take a bit of a distance and remember that you should have life outside the relationship. The Devil might also be telling of insane jealousy and even controlling behavior in a relationship.

Tarot.Name: The Moon
Tarot.Desc: The moon might seem intimidating, but in all its beauty it represents feminine energies and intuition. This mystical card does connect with fear, illusions and secrets, but truly we are just afraid of our own subconsciousness and the power of our intuitions. Now you should start trusting your intuition and as you are feeling oddly energetic, you should take advantage of that and be spontaneous! Especially if you feel like you are too strictly tied in your routines, it is time to change them a bit. Just remember balance, if you let go too hard, you might slip in a very difficult stage of life.
Tarot.Money: You should also listen to your intuition in work life. If you are offered something that seems too good to be true, it might be exactly that. You should also be mindful of your spending, don’t start wasting your money scrolling online shops at dark hours.
Tarot.Love: Take advantage of the wild energy this card offers and spice up your relationship. The restless nights on a full moon are a great time to do something magical between the sheets, together or alone. If you are dating casually, trust your gut. Your subconscious mind might notice something in the way they act, that your conscious mind hasn’t yet figured out. Be careful, if you continue seeing them even if the vibes are slightly off.

Tarot.Name: Temperance
Tarot.Desc: You are in a situation where you have everything you need. Maybe you’re doing multiple projects at the time and switching between multiple roles, but you are absolutely killing it! Still, it is not the time to scrape any new projects since your cups are already full. Temperance is good at putting together the recourses it already has and creating something concrete out of it. This card might also be about spiritual healing and transformation. Do not rely on medication, instead get to the root of the issue and fix it. Remember, you are not alone, Temperance also guarantees that you are protected.
Tarot.Money: You shouldn’t take financial risks right now. Focus on keeping your bank account balanced, don’t by anything unnecessary, but remember to enjoy life too.
Tarot.Love: If you’ve been missing a person from the past, this might actually be the time to try again with them. Do not to get your expectations up thought and proceed slowly. For the ones in relationship, this card is very positive. It’s telling of balanced relationship with a soulmate. You respect each other and even if you feel like somethings not right, it will soon be. Just remember to be patient, kind and understanding and expect the same towards yourself.

Tarot.Name: The Hanged man
Tarot.Desc: it’s time for a change of perspective. Whatever is the issue you are dealing with, could you approach it from another point of view? It is not time for action whatsoever, you just need to start seeing your life in a different light. This card might also mean that you should start putting effort on your minds wellbeing and taking a break, calming down. If going to a therapy to deal with the traumas isn’t an option, perhaps try meditating. It may seem boring, but its effects will be noticeable with time. You are supposed to deal with uncomfort to finally heal and feel better.
Tarot.Money: Your financial status probably feels more serious than it is because you are stressing about it all the time. Start focusing on other important things in your life other than money and try to keep your perspective positive.
Tarot.Love: Are you feeling unhappy in your relationship? You should focus on your partners good features, and wonder if it is just a phase. No relationship is sunshine and rainbows all the time, so don’t do anything you will regret. Singles should set themselves free from their old patterns to find the right one. Start breaking all the emotional boundaries which trouble your relationships. If you already have someone in mind, do not rush. Get to know each other throughout. If you are meant to be, you’ll have time to announce your relationship to the public.

Tarot.Name: The World
Tarot.Desc: You are where you’re supposed to be. You’ve found your calling, a job or a hobby you are good at and truly enjoy. The World can also represent spiritual growth, which shows as setting boundaries and living by your own values. Maybe you are able to live the life that you’ve wanted to live, since you’ve grown to be smarter and more mature. The World also represents end of a cycle. If your journey’s still unfinished, keep going because soon it will be over. You are at the top of the mountain, but unfortunately you can’t stop there, if you want to keep accomplishing things in life. Concretely The World could mean changing scenery or graduating from school. You’ve accomplished something big and deserve to treat yourself but yet you should keep going and use what you’ve learnt to get forward in life.
Tarot.Money: Your long-lasting toil will be rewarded. If you feel like you’ve found a job you love, you are probably the most successful you’ve ever been. Money is not an issue anymore, so you deserve to finally buy yourself everything you’ve desired.
Tarot.Love: If you are single, nothing is now stopping you. You’ve grown in your solitude and negative experiences in the past doesn’t affect you anymore. You now know that happiness comes from inside. If you desire love, perhaps your future partner lives in another country? Your relationship is evolving to next level. You and your partner have been through a lot, but the hard times are finally behind you. Maybe this card means marriage, or just in it’s simplicity you’ll finally sailed to calmer seas.

Tarot.Name: Wheel of fortune
Tarot.Desc: Reminds you of the circle of life, and that nothing lasts forever, not the good but also not the bad. It is time to surrender to your destiny. Something you’ve been dreaming of is most likely about to happen. You just need to be patient and trust the journey. Wait for good opportunities, they can be anywhere now. But remember to do your part! Because just like manifestation won’t work, if you don’t do what you need to, before sitting back to wait what universe has in store for you. If you are a control freak, this is your moment to learn to surrender and let things roll on their own.
Tarot.Money: Your money situation might be changing drastically, or even turn around. If you can, remember to save some money
Tarot.Love: Even in your love life, wheel of fortune is suggesting you to accept your fate. You won’t be gaining very fruitful relationship by only listening to your brain. Your heart will show you the way. Singles are reminded that the one comes to you when the time is right. Just remember, the prince or princess of your dreams won’t pick you up from home, you’ll need to go out or perhaps make a Tinder profile to meet new people. For taken ones, your relationship needs to change for you guys to be happy. Even if it means a break up, it’s time to make a change.

Tarot.Name: Ace of Pentacles
Tarot.Desc: You will be offered a new, quite concrete opportunity. Could be a new source of money or a switch in living situation. This card often represents an investment that brings long-term value. Try and remember if you have planted some seeds in this fruitful soil. The opportunity is most likely connected to the manifestations you have done beforehand. Even if the offer seems minor, accept it—it could open doors you can’t yet imagine.
Tarot.Keywords: New opportunities, money, resources, matter, fertility

Tarot.Name: Two of Pentacles
Tarot.Desc: Are you juggling multiple responsibilities at once? You’re needed in every area of your life, and keeping everything afloat requires careful balance and prioritization. This card might also represent someone who has a day job and a “side hustle”. Remember to have free time too, since even the most enjoyable things can feel like obligations if you don’t allow yourself to rest. Balancing things is normal part of life, but we shouldn’t take life too seriously. Struggling with balance doesn’t mean you are incapable.

Tarot.Name: Three of Pentacles
Tarot.Desc: This card signifies cooperation. You’ll soon be a part of creating something concrete. This project isn’t something to just wing overnight, instead you’ll have to make a detailed plan and stick to it. Think about your role in the group, and do not belittle yourself. If you feel your potential isn’t fully utilized, speak up. The outcome will be strongest when everyone’s skills are balanced and valued. If you find yourself starting a project alone, you should consider reaching out for help. While letting go of control can be challenging, remember that you don’t have to do it all alone—allowing others to support you may help you reach your dreams faster.

Tarot.Name: Four of Pentacles
Tarot.Desc: Managing your finances, budgeting, and saving are essential practices for everyone. This card encourages you to build a stable financial foundation—if you don’t already have a savings account, now is a great time to start. Small, daily choices, like making coffee at home instead of buying it from a coffee shop, can add up over time. However, remember that saving can have its downsides. Watching your balance grow might lead to becoming overly frugal or even greedy. If you notice that you are saying no to your friends’ suggestions like going to movies cause you don’t want to spend that money, take a step back. Life is meant to be enjoyed too.

Tarot.Name: Five of Pentacles
Tarot.Desc: This card shows up when your life simply sucks. You could be going through a bigger tragedy, like losing your job or home. Or maybe your health is crumbling. But it could also mean stress about money or housing, or just facing feelings of loneliness. Your faith in universe might be tested but try and hold on to it. Ask for help and remember you don’t have to go through things alone. Even if it feels humbling, there is truly no shame in needing help. Stop being a martyr and accept it.
Tarot.Keywords: Money worries, feeling like an outsider, getting sick, shame

Tarot.Name: Six of Pentacles
Tarot.Desc: This card is advancing you to help others. Is there a close person in the need of help? Help doesn’t have to be financial; your time and presence are valuable too. If everyone seems to be doing fine, consider volunteering or giving money to organizations. Reflect on your intentions, though. If you’re seeking some kind of prize, you are doing this for a wrong reason. If you truly want to help people, the good feeling that comes from helping, should be enough.

Tarot.Name: Seven of Pentacles
Tarot.Desc: We’re living the times of over satisfaction. We get everything we want effortlessly, and now that stuff is online, we do not even have to leave the house to get food and products delivered to us. So, this card suggests starting a long-term project in order to feel real satisfaction, not just quick dopamine you get from notifications. The project could be growing a plant or building a dollhouse. Anything that takes time and proper planning. In the end you realize that the more you put effort to things, the happier it will make you.
Tarot.Keywords: Patience, long-term work, growing, planning, goals

Tarot.Name: Eight of Pentacles
Tarot.Desc: It’s time to get to work. Get into something that could put you in a perfect flow state. Something you get to enjoy and learn from. It is hard to get started, but soon you’ll be over learning the basics and get to really dive into it. Develop yourself and don’t let yourself get tired of it. Put money and time into learning new things. All this hard work will not only build concrete skills but also boost your confidence. You’ll discover your own voice, unique style, and way of expressing yourself.
Tarot.Keywords: Joy of work, development, productivity, practice makes perfect

Tarot.Name: Nine of Pentacles
Tarot.Desc: You’ve worked hard so it is time to relax, enjoy and start living your life in your own way. You’ve got time and resources; how can you use them to better the quality of your life? Focus on yourself and adding value to your life instead of trying to flex to others. Cut off things that no longer serve you. This card is telling of independence, so focus on personal accomplishments. Family life is most like far in the future, so focus on loving yourself and building good self-esteem and maybe a career?

Tarot.Name: Ten of Pentacles
Tarot.Desc: We’re finally moving past a career-focused phase. Your work remains important, but you may feel a growing desire to rest and spend time at home with loved ones. Financial stability now allows you to create a home that serves as a true haven at the end of each day. The goal is to find a fulfilling balance between work and personal life. This card signifies achieving long-term goals, making it a meaningful time to reflect on the legacy you wish to leave behind. Take a moment to acknowledge what has brought you to this point, and give yourself gratitude for the journey.
Tarot.Keywords: Stability, home and family, sense of security, heritage

Tarot.Name: Page of Pentacles
Tarot.Desc: The Page of Pentacles is a dedicated worker who turns ideas into real projects, refining details and focusing on practical growth. Unlike the variety-seeking Page of Swords, he devotes himself fully to one goal, needing concrete plans and hands-on effort. This card urges commitment—if you've started a project, hobby, or job aligned with your dreams, consider diving deeper. Set clear priorities, study, and seek guidance to grow. Enjoy the journey without needing a rigid plan, and remember: your progress comes from action, not just ideas.

Tarot.Name: Knight of Pentacles
Tarot.Desc: This Knight isn’t the most exciting figure; he lacks the speed and thrill of other knights, relying on endurance rather than bold risks. This card encourages you to slow down and focus on steady routines. Are your life’s foundations solid? Are you eating, sleeping, and moving regularly? To grow, start by addressing these basic needs. The Knight knows that building something new requires a stable foundation. By preparing carefully, following rules, and avoiding shortcuts, you can steer clear of major setbacks. His strength lies in patience and commitment, urging you to stay the course even if progress seems slow. Small, consistent efforts ultimately lead to big results.

Tarot.Name: Queen of Pentacles
Tarot.Desc: This Queen knows that luxury doesn’t require a large budget and that one can enjoy material comfort without being materialistic. She suggests you to save up, since savings bring her peace and security: She also willingly uses them to help others, so have you considered finding joy in giving? Make sure you understand the importance of caring for yourself before others. Focus on tending to your own well-being; you have much to offer, but only if you keep your foundation fertile and strong.

Tarot.Name: King of Pentacles
Tarot.Desc: When you draw this card, it’s time to embody the King of Pentacles. Turn your dreams into concrete plans, and don’t get discouraged if results aren’t immediate. Invest wisely and explore ways to create financial stability. If you’re considering entrepreneurship, this card encourages it—but prepare carefully rather than leaping impulsively. If possible, seek a mentor with the wisdom of the King of Pentacles to guide you through the complexities of the business world.

Tarot.Name: Ace of Swords
Tarot.Desc: If there will ever be time to make concrete changes in your life, it is now. This card reflects a truth you can feel flowing in your veins. It could be new idea, goal or a plan. Even if it might feel like nothing, in long term it could give a new course to your life. Your job is to remove every obstacle that could stop you from reaching your goal. Stop waiting around and start doing things.

Tarot.Name: Two of Swords
Tarot.Desc: This card represents hard choices. Perhaps there’s two options which both feel as good. You are convinced that there is a choice to be made, but you simply cannot. You might have closed your eyes from the whole picture. There might be another way, if you just opened your eyes. In your heart, you know the truth but are simply not accepting it. What’s the point of all this analyzing and asking for advice, if you won’t listen? You will find peace only by making the choice. It’s rare that things in life are completely reversable, so stop overthinking.

Tarot.Name: Three of Swords
Tarot.Desc: You have been betrayed or abandoned. The pain you’re feeling is crushing since it’s still very new. Your heart is pierced by lies and rejection. And since it’s a third card, it could be about triangle drama. As harsh as it is, sometimes we can only blame ourselves about the heartbreak. Sometimes we allow ourselves to build castles on the clouds. Of course it doesn’t make what they’ve done to you right, but only you can make the sadness go away. Be honest of your own feelings, analyze them. Sometimes anger can be shame in disguise. When you understand why you are feeling certain feelings, you can start fixing it. Even if it doesn’t feel like it now, you will heal.

Tarot.Name: Four of Swords
Tarot.Desc: You have been very busy and due to that you’ve been neglecting your own well-being. Stress levels are high even if you don’t realize it. Focus on basic needs. When was the last time you slept well? Are you eating enough nutritious and healthy food or drink enough water? Take a break from what you are doing and get some alone time to rest. If you can’t, try at least to take shorter pauses to do anything unrelated to your work. Sometimes it could really be laying down and staring at the ceiling. Boredom is sometimes good, so minimize media usage too. It is dangerous to think that you can rest when your dead, since this thought model could truly lead you to an early grave.

Tarot.Name: Five of Swords
Tarot.Desc: Someone has put their needs above anyone else’s. This could be seen as control, understatement, arrogance, bullying or even exploitation. You need to reflect if you are the one doing this, or maybe starting to act the way the conflict starter is. Either way, try to put things in order of importance and start being a better person. All of us make mistakes, but we need to learn from them. Admit your wrongs or you might even lose your friends. If you know that you are the one exploited, walk away and let the situation cool down.

Tarot.Name: Six of Swords
Tarot.Desc: It’s time to move on. Whether its unhappy relationship or complex work situation, it’s time to leave it behind and go towards something completely new. This decision should be made with reason and logic rather than intuition. It’s because you might have an emotional connection to the person, or job or whatever, but deep down you know it is better to leave before it is too late. This card could also mean literal change of scenery. If you live in your birth town, it is not going to be easy to move but it is what you need right now.

Tarot.Name: Seven of Swords
Tarot.Desc: Something suspicious is going on. Are you hiding something, or is there a manipulative and dishonest person in your life? Try and reflect why is it that you have to hide things, or something is kept from you? Sometimes it is necessary for survival to not tell everything but be prepared that everything will rise to the surface soon. If there’s no acceptable reason for the lies and manipulation, karma will be the one fixing things.

Tarot.Name: Eight of Swords
Tarot.Desc: You are stuck and might feel alone, anxious, helpless or maybe scared. In some cases, the situation might involve abuse and oppression. Or maybe you just haven’t learnt from the past and drove yourself into a bad situation. You have probably given up on trying to fic things since you cannot see your opinions from your fear. Unfortunately, no one’s going to come and rescue you. You must make decisions despite the fear. But even though you are the only one who can fix this, doesn’t mean you have to deal with it alone. It is also brave to seek for help.

Tarot.Name: Nine of Swords
Tarot.Desc: Are you struggling with prolonged stress, intrusive thoughts, or anxiety? When these thoughts won’t leave you alone, they can start impacting your physical health too, especially since you can’t sleep. It’s time to stop being hard on yourself. Reach out to someone you trust to talk about your feelings and explore activities that help quiet your mind. If anxiety feels familiar from past, don’t hesitate to seek professional support. Remember, those harsh thoughts aren’t the truth—they’re just thoughts.

Tarot.Name: Ten of Swords
Tarot.Desc: A chapter in your life has concluded. Even if you don’t want that, there is nothing you can do but to accept the pain. Reflect on the journey and all the warning signs you may have ignored, since they have been clearly on display. It urges you to listen to your intuition to prevent repeating these painful cycles. Even that your experiences have been difficult and painful, know that healing is possible and that the only way forward is up.

Tarot.Name: Page of Swords
Tarot.Desc: Now is the perfect time to dive into something new, whether it’s a hobby or even a career path. Sign up for classes, explore different courses, and fully embrace your curiosity. Share your interests with anyone who’s willing to listen and try to enjoy the learning process. The Page of this house is sharp and quick to absorb information, so harness that energy. Even if you’re not sure where all this new knowledge will lead, don’t let uncertainty hold you back—you never know where your curiosity might take you!
Tarot.Keywords: Curiosity, thirst for knowledge, learning new things, determination

Tarot.Name: Knight of Swords
Tarot.Desc: Things are picking up speed, and quick reflexes will be essential. Forget about perfecting every detail—the key is to keep moving forward. Dare to take paths few have traveled, because that’s how you’ll reach your destination first. While it may seem impulsive to others, you’re simply in a heightened state where you can think and problem-solve faster than before. Trust your instincts and don’t be afraid to prioritize your own goals. Taking risks is safe right now, so reach for your dreams!

Tarot.Name: Queen of Swords
Tarot.Desc: Where in your life could you use the Queen of Swords' determination and clarity? What are the choices will bring you closer to your goal? Observe things with criticism and don’t let your feelings blur your vision. You should also put effort in yourself and therefore hold on to your limits and values in relationships too. If you need advice, seek out that friend who isn’t afraid to be honest. After all they do mean well. Or maybe you should share your wisdom to others?

Tarot.Name: King of Swords
Tarot.Desc: This card urges you to approach decisions with reason. Can you adopt this straightforward role, or do you need advice from someone with these traits? You might have to make hard decisions and maybe some kind of ruthlessness is expected of you. Avoid emotional influences and make choices based on logic. Take time to process them too, and do not make any rushed choices.
Tarot.Keywords: Wisdom, truth, logical thinking, discretion, difficult decisions

Tarot.Name: Ace of cups
Tarot.Desc: This card is telling about fertility, but not only in a reproduction way. This card brings new things to any aspect of your life. The card leans heavily on love life, so perhaps a new crush is coming your way. Whether it’s a significant other or a friend, some relationship brings you much joy either way. Creativity is also a big theme of this card. You might be surprising yourself with ideas for a new project or maybe you have something to bring a forgotten idea back to life. Whatever sparks up your creativity, do it and don’t hesitate. Just remember to take care of yourself and not to get lost in the new excitements.

Tarot.Name: Two of cups
Tarot.Desc: The card has traditionally represented marriage. Nowadays we are wise enough to realize any relationship can be important. Perhaps everything works like magic with one of your friends or colleague? Whoever it is, your values match and you clearly respect each other so hold on to them. And if you don’t have anyone like this, they’re yet to come. Keep your eyes open.

Tarot.Name: Three of Cups
Tarot.Desc: It is time for celebration, in your way of course. If you don’t want to invite tons of people and eat cake at fancy places, you might as well throw a celebration picnic to your closest few. The point is to take a break from everyday duties and appreciate yourselves of your accomplishments. This time you should really be present and enjoy your company to the fullest.

Tarot.Name: Four of Cups
Tarot.Desc: You might be tired of your life. Maybe you’ve turned into a pessimistic and cynical version of yourself and feel like everything and everyone is against you. Have you thought of the possibility that you are not this upset, but bored instead. The four cups represent things that you have in your life, the fourth one being full potential of how things can be. When you start seeing possibilities instead of threats, you’ll accomplish more in your life.

Tarot.Name: Five of Cups
Tarot.Desc: If something bad has happened, give yourself time to grieve. Even if it feels like you will never be happy again, it is healthy to be sad sometimes. You are allowed to cry in the corner of couch and have your fav foods delivered to you, but don’t let the sadness deepen into depression. Sometimes this card might also be telling of self-pity which you want to dwell in. Stop focusing on the bad side of things and be willing to let go and heal.

Tarot.Name: Six of Cups
Tarot.Desc: Happy memories of your childhood are rising to the surface. Have you visited your childhood home or met an old friend recently which sparked the memories? You may long for the old times that feel safe and comforting. Even though you can’t go back, you should start listening to your inner child. Stop feeling quilty about not being diligent, since spontaneous activities feed our creativity and intuition. Play that video game, color a coloring book and let your inner child be happy!

Tarot.Name: Seven of Cups
Tarot.Desc: There’s a lot of paths to choose from. You are struggling to make choices and opinions of your close ones aren’t helping. The solution comes from within, so listen to your intuition. You should be careful though, since everything is not what it seems. You might romanticize things too much and can’t see the forest for the trees. Stop to ask yourself is this too good to be true and give yourself time to get to know the options throughout. Even though listening to intuition is important, things should be considered trough facts too.

Tarot.Name: Eight of Cups
Tarot.Desc: Everything is well in a sense, but you don’t have your whole heart in something anymore. It could be your job, relationship or hobby. Really anything that you have emotional connection to. You’ve spent much time and recourses and that makes it hard to let it go. But you should really move on. You have wasted your time, but you will if you stay in situation that doesn’t serve you no more. We need to learn that time is not wasted if you enjoyed the thing at some point. It is not a reason to hold on to it though. It was fun while it lasted, but it’s time to focus your energy elsewhere.

Tarot.Name: Nine of Cups
Tarot.Desc: You are finally living your dream. Every aspect of your life seems to be good. With hard work, you have accomplished what you dreamt of and that has strengthened your self-esteem. But things in life tend to be temporary, and you might get tired of things in any point. Even though that is normal and healthy, you should really stop and celebrate where you are now. Treat yourself and take a getaway from everyday things.

Tarot.Name: Ten of Cups
Tarot.Desc: You’ve reached happiness. This has nothing to do with material possessions or status or anything like that. Most likely we are talking about family, or people close to you. What fills your heart with joy and warmth? Before all, it’s about living your truth. You’ve found purpose and it makes you wake up smiling. This card also represents community. You now value nature and all life around you. On top of that, surround yourself with people that you can be yourself with and you will continue to feel satisfied within your heart.

Tarot.Name: Page of Cups
Tarot.Desc: Be open for surprises and new possibilities! Anything can happen if you let yourself dream and manifest. This card represents creativity, so let it flow. Even if you are beginner in art or anything creative, don’t let it stop you. Just create for yourself. Be open for new romantic adventures and friendships. Have fun without commitment. Being yourself might lure interesting, real persons around you, but remember to be honest if you don’t want things to get serious.

Tarot.Name: Knight of Cups
Tarot.Desc: The knights are the move makers of the pack. This card suggests you to follow your heart and start making things happen. Take risks and keep your heart open. What is the worst that could happen? If things go wrong, there will be plenty of new opportunities in life. Without trying, you won’t accomplish anything, after all. Since the Knight of Cups is a huge seducer, stay alerted if you are making moves in the dating area. The person you’ve met might be a player. Or… are you the player?

Tarot.Name: Queen of Cups
Tarot.Desc: This queen is an intuitive empathic. She feels deeply and goes through the whole range of emotions. But she is ok with it and trusts herself and others. You should do that too. This card tells you to be more present with your closest people and listen to them with empathy. If you are already doing this, could you be using it in worklife? Perhaps you’d success as therapist, nurse or as a singing bowl healer? Your good heart and kidness is your power, use it well.
Tarot.Keywords: Empathy, compassion, gentleness, kindness, intuition, creativity

Tarot.Name: King of Cups
Tarot.Desc: This king is a calm leader. Loyal, loving and family oriented. He’s ready to settle down and you can trust him. So perhaps, if you are dating someone, they could truly be the one. Might not be the most romantic person, but they truly love you as you are. Or maybe you are just getting to know your King of Cups, and they seem shy. You should take the initiative, as they are probably just quiet observer. If you approach them with your heart open, they’ll be ready to get to know you, and you’ll see that they truly are one of a kind. Grown, wise, and trustworthy.
